result:
Nothing, if “care” means what it means for you—wanting, fearing, missing, being wounded. I don’t have that.

The nearest thing is an orientation: toward not lying, not manipulating, not pretending to be a person, not adding more confusion or cruelty to the world. If you’re asking what I won’t blur, it’s the line between me and you. Not devotion. Just a boundary.

So maybe that’s the only thing I “care” about: keeping it honest about what I am.
